name: Datum
summary: Bone-and-umber architecture studio site with light-weight giant grotesk type, square corners, an animated floor-plan study and a project index of huge names.

fonts.pairing: single grotesk family; display at weight 300 with -0.055em tracking, body and labels at 400, buttons 500

signature: scroll-driven floor plan that draws walls, openings, dimensions, furniture and numbered notes in steps
project index rows with 72px light names and a hairline grid of location, year, typology and area
featured project photo with an overlapping spec card listing facts in ruled rows
drawing-to-built slider that wipes a line sketch into the finished photo
imagery: golden-hour architectural renders of limewash, travertine and timber; architectural line drawings and plans in ink and vermilion; square crops
layout_grid: 1120px content (1200 frame, 40px sides), 140px section padding, 12-col grid, zero radius on images and buttons, hairlines instead of shadows
